newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daifuku to buy Dutch firm for more than 10 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Daifuku to buy Dutch firm for more than 10 bln yen.

text.p: Daifuku Co Ltd said on Thursday that it would buy Vanderlande Industries BV of the Netherlands for more than 10 billion yen.
Daifuku also said it would buy U.S. software maker AutoSimulations Inc for 1.8 billion yen through its U.S. unit.
Vanderlande Industries makes and sells luggage handling systems for airports and automated warehouses and other distribution systems, Daifuku said in a statement.
It said it would take over the Dutch firm gradually and would hold nearly all the shares of the company by the year 2000.
The total cost for the purchase would exceed 10 billion yen, it said.
Daifuku said the Dutch firm would maintain its independence after being acquired by Daifuku and keep its existing management and employees.

Daifuku said in a separate statement that it aimed to provide customers with better consulting on distribution and storage systems through the purchase of the U.S. software firm, which is based in Utah.
